lyrics:
[Intro: warm electric guitar, soft brushed drums]

[Verse 1: tender male tenor]
There's a travel show on, some island, some sea
You say, "Don't you want to go?" and look over at me
You got flour on your elbow, one sock on the floor
Honey, look around. What would I go there for?

[Chorus: smooth, soulful, harmonies behind]
'Cause I'm already there
Kitchen light, your feet in my chair
Every postcard place I ever wanted to see
Is sitting right here, stealing fries from me
They can keep the islands and the mountain air
Honey, I'm already there

[Verse 2: tenor, band a little fuller]
I used to keep a list in the back of my head
Things to do, things to own, before I'm dead
Then a Tuesday with you and a pizza and rain
Crossed off every line, and I ain't felt the same

[Chorus: smooth, soulful, harmonies behind]
'Cause I'm already there
Kitchen light, your feet in my chair
Every postcard place I ever wanted to see
Is sitting right here, stealing fries from me
They can keep the islands and the mountain air
Honey, I'm already there

[Bridge: guitar and voice only]
If the good Lord called and said, "Time's up, son"
I'd say, "That's alright. I already won."

[Final Chorus: fullest, organ and harmonies]
'Cause I'm already there
Kitchen light, your feet in my chair
Every postcard place I ever wanted to see
Is sitting right here, stealing fries from me
They can keep the islands and the mountain air
Honey, I'm already there

[Outro: guitar, a television murmuring, spoken]
Change it if you want.
No. I like watching you watch it.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 82 BPM, 4/4 with a soul sway, D major. Slow, warm and close, a kitchen slow dance.

VOICE: Male tenor, soft and sincere, with a light Southern accent and a little falsetto at the ends of chorus lines. Gentle harmonies behind him. Two spoken lines at the end, the first one hers.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean, warm electric guitar playing soul chords, brushed drums with a soft rim click, round bass, electric piano, a quiet organ in the last chorus, a touch of pedal steel.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro guitar. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:10 Verse 2. 1:38 Chorus 2. 2:08 Bridge, guitar and voice. 2:26 Final chorus. 2:56 Outro, the television and two spoken lines, ends 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2015 country with a soul heart: soft, round and intimate, no hard edges, voice close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I like watching you watch it' at 3:10.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young husband's vow. This is the same vow kept: years later, with nothing left to prove and nowhere better to be.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Asked, amused, certain, at rest.
